about_the_game:
The debut game book by Kudomos; an epic adventure of sorcery! Playing as a Gilded Sky acolyte, and issued a quest upon graduation from the Sky Guild, you'll navigate the high fantasy landscape steeped in dungeons and dragons lore.

In this 2d6 dice narrative adventure game book, you face up to skill, luck or stamina challenges with the roll of the die:

Find creatures and puzzles along the way, as you are presented with the ever expansive quest of the Ancients. In a self-motivated journey the avatar must decide on not only their own fate, but that of the entire realm in this story rich, & choice rich adventure featuring over 40 unique and gory deaths should you choose unwisely.

short_description: A 2d6 dice narrative adventure game book. Play as an acolyte of the Gilded Order. Venture out on quests with the Spellbook of Sky under the guise of the Ancients. Death and folly reign in this world of Dungeons and Dragons, where the realm is torn under warring clans you'll come to discover.
